summary: More than most people, a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think for yourself and break the mold, you imagine, feel for others, and create. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: More than most people, a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think for yourself and break the mold, you imagine, feel for others, and create. It rewards you when you reach for it. Generational and visionary themes rather than a personal day-to-day read.
gift: At your best: you think for yourself and break the mold, and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
shadow: The trap: you blow things up just to feel free, or you feel out of control - or you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline.
integration: Let freedom and disruption and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Generational and visionary themes rather than a personal day-to-day read.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think for yourself and you imagine, feel for others, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You blow things up just to feel free
Let the reflex make the decision
